name: zdeclient_create_feature_node_and_di_from_clip_patch_partition
description: zDEClient::CreateFeatureNodeAndDiFromClipPatchPartition allocates an Object3D feature node, derives its node type from contributing partition nodes, marks it as generated, allocates a display instance, attaches it to the parent, and binds the display instance to the node.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zDEClient/zGeometry feature-node source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46af40 validates null partition return, gwObject3DInit allocation, default child node type 0xff, scanning partition node/DI pairs for flag 0x10000 and first non-0xff node type, setting flag 17, allocating a zDi from the pool, deleting the node on DI allocation failure, adding the child to the parent, setting the node display instance, and returning the allocated zDi.

The native zDEClient feature-node smoke verifies the success path: derived node type, generated-node flag, parent/child linkage, display-instance binding/refcount, DI pool consumption, and null partition rejection.
